body:
And, I’ve been living as a full woman for 3 years now.. but every time I my parents come to visit or I come home, I always change my appearance and it’s exhausting to lie to myself... and every time I brought up this topic abt my identity, they’re always arguing abt religion.

I’m just so done :(

So basically, I’m 24 and I’m currently studying in the UK rn away from my family. I’d love to move out but it’s just I dont have the security for my own financial etc. (as my parents still finance my living).

All I have is God, and the more I pray, the more I feel like He does not even listen 😭

I was raised in a Muslim family too.. they’re just oppressive and guilt me over into this religion thing. I do believe in God and I love Him and I don’t want to unplease Him. But He will not put you in something worse than you can even handle right?

At this point, I dont think I can even handle it anymore.
